AboutMe.firstParagraph: Hello! I’m Diego Teixeira Fialho, a Senior Frontend Engineer with over 11 years of experience building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications. I enjoy working on products where user experience, performance, and code quality truly matter. My main focus is developing responsive, accessible, and maintainable interfaces using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and CSS.
AboutMe.secondParagraph: In my day-to-day work, I like designing reusable components, improving application performance, collaborating closely with designers and backend engineers, and contributing to architectural decisions. Writing clean, well-tested code and continuously refining existing solutions are core parts of how I approach development.
AboutMe.thirdParagraph: Outside of work, I enjoy exploring new web technologies, playing video games, watching movies and TV series, and spending quality time outdoors with my wife and son. I believe curiosity, consistency, and balance are essential for long-term growth as a developer.
